proof_body:
by
  intro X _ K f hK hne hf
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hmax⟩ := hK.exists_isMaxOn hne hf
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hmin⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn hne hf
  exact ⟨⟨c, hc, fun x hx => isMaxOn_iff.mp hmax x hx⟩, ⟨d, hd, fun x hx => isMinOn_iff.mp hmin x hx⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] (K : Set X) (f : X → ℝ), IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → ContinuousOn f K → (∃ c ∈ K, ∀ x ∈ K, f x ≤ f c) ∧ (∃ d ∈ K, ∀ x ∈ K, f d ≤ f x)
